verdict.rationale: Feitian documents its own management apps: iePassManager on Android handles "credential related operations" on FIDO devices, and SK Manager manages the key's FIDO functions. That indicates first-party credential management, but listing and deleting passkeys are never named explicitly. On capacity, the only statement is that the MultiPass key has "no limit to the number of accounts registered", in a U2F context; it is not a way to see resident-credential capacity or remaining slots. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of listing and deleting resident passkeys, a way to view credential capacity or remaining slots across models, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can list and delete the passkeys stored on my key and know its credential capacity before it fills up
